summary.intent: Drive the ADR 0025 declaration-scope work forward across sequential branches (scope identity, then resolve-by-scope), and determine whether the fixes needed for a useful oracle run are in place.
summary.outcome: Scope-identity PR #378 and benchmarks PR #377 were merged, and a worker was started on ADR branch 2 (resolve interfaces by scope). The oracle readiness question was answered as unknown: no gap list exists and no baseline run has been done yet.

repo: SourceData is positional MessagePack (ADR 0003); adding or reshaping fields requires bumping CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (now 31) with a changelog line in cache.rs and updating the golden snapshot and fixture.

In an ordinary worktree, snapshot and CLI tests fail because an ancestor node_modules leaks into paths; a clean-room checkout in /tmp with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` gives reliable results (1286 passed).
`just semver` reports breaking API changes as covered by pending changesets for caliper-docgen-core, so no new changeset was needed for SourceData field changes.
Clippy forbids `expect_used` in this repo; fmt and clippy fixes were needed before lint passed (`just lint doc-check machete typos`).
docs/edge-cases.md entries are removed only when the ADR 0025 branch that closes them lands, so earlier branches must not touch it.
The oracle is `scripts/weekly.py --oracle`: it compares TypeScript 7.1 checker types with caliper `--json` output, is informational only per docs/measurement.md, and reports agree vs `wrong` shares.
Most props only the checker reports are Next's ambient augmentation (1,154 of 1,182 on shadcn), which ADR 0025 lists as out of scope.
ADR 0025 branches change the same extractor files, so they must run one at a time.

code.finding: The collector keeps scope_path and scope_children and calls enter_scope/leave_scope in namespace, external module, block, static block, function body and the new switch case visitors.

SourceData gained interface_scopes, type_alias_scopes and class_scopes; enum_declarations changed from a set to a map of key to DeclarationScope. DeclarationScope is Vec<ScopeStep>, with ScopeKind of Namespace, FunctionBody, Block or SwitchCase, and an empty path means module.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority and should be verified, e.g. by re-checking PR state.
Perf measurements should not run in parallel with other heavy work such as an oracle run, which would skew the timings.
Prove tests fail before the change; tests that cannot compile without the new fields fail only by construction.
Interleaved repeated runs (9 each) with medians against origin/main give a reliable perf comparison on Chakra.

friction: Worktree test failures from ancestor node_modules leaking into paths forced clean-room runs in /tmp.
The first scope-identity commits needed rebasing after fmt and clippy fixes.
The oracle run could not be started because the branch 2 worker was timing builds on the same machine.
No documented list of oracle gaps exists, so readiness could not be assessed without a run.
open_items: Finish ADR branch 2: resolve interfaces by scope and drop local_depth and module_interfaces.
Run the oracle on antd and shadcn at main c5fbb33e as a baseline, then again after branch 2 merges, and turn real `wrong` entries into fixes.
ADR branches 3 to 5 (switch case scope, aliases/enums/classes, type-only imports) are held until branch 2 merges.
Enums inside functions and blocks are still not collected, and synthesized __anon_N aliases have no scope.
The SPEC/AC tag re-scan is held until the ADR branches settle.
PR #291 (0.10.0 release bot) still awaits the user's review.
The scope-measure.py measurement script is not committed.
